building.title: Kenneth Myers Centre, University of Auckland
building.note: outline: traced from the LiDAR (building.outline_note), in the map's frame; chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). campus_outline: building 820's outline from the main project's campus.json, kept for the record; the site replaces block 820 by its id, and topview measures the share of that block under the model.
building.outline_note: traced from the LiDAR's roofs and wall returns in the view frame of frame.expected (walls fitted to the returns: front z 16.2, porch front 14.8, east front 11.6, back -12.6, west x -16.7; the east wall from (21.4, 11.6) to (19.9, -12.6), skewed 3.5 deg as its parapet's returns run), taken to the map's frame. campus.json's outline (campus_outline) lies about 2 m north of the building's front and back (its front edge at z 11.8-12.7 against the LiDAR's 16.2; its back at -11.6 to -13.8 against -12.6) and adds a west tail (x -21.6 to -15, z -19 to -3) over the low lane beside the tower to the west and an east nub (x 21 to 27, z 7 to 13) over the low roofs to the east. Within 1.5 m of it the first data run took 94% of the building's roof returns, the mast's, and none of the tower's (no return above 40 m), but cut off the front 2 m of the street face (z 14.2 to 16.2 west of x 1.3) and its south-west corner; so the points are chosen by this ring, within 1.0 m of it. (The data stage's heightmap figure draws the map-frame outline without taking it to NZTM, so there it stands about 5 m off: most of that is the frame difference heightmap.py names.)

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) within near_outline m of building 820's outline from campus.json (the first data run, before the outline was traced from the LiDAR: building.outline_note): centre = mean x/y of points higher than tower_above m: the front range's and the two roof blocks' tops at 10.0-10.2 m and the mast; axis = the bearing of most of the walls seen from above (axis_from walls), the one of the two square to each other nearest the principal axis of the points from min_above to spine_below m within spine_radius m, pointing west-south-west (street_side east); toStreet = the axis turned 90 deg toward street_side: south-south-east, to Shortland Street. With the traced ring and near_outline 1.0 the centre would be 0.73 m from this one (x -0.41, z +0.61 in this frame): the model, the cameras and the placement keep frame.expected.
